narrative:
## Handover Summary — Intercompany & Eliminations

Agreed balances are eliminated for the consolidated view. Remaining mismatches have a confirmed root cause and an owner.

## Key Decisions
• Goods-in-transit entries posted on both sides for 31 October warehouse deliveries
• Sport 1 marketing-fund timing aligned to the membership agreement schedule
• North region ski-stock returns matched to credit memos and sent for confirmation

## Recommendation for Accruals & Flux
Check that the goods-in-transit entries do not double count the GRNI accrual on the same receipts.

signals.title: Hybrid ownership — store-owner settlement
signals.excerpt: Intersport and Sport 1 stores are partly owned by local store owners. Group invoices goods, marketing fund and services; balances must be agreed store by store before consolidation.
